reference: Torres, Claret, Pavlovski & Dotter 2015, ApJ 807, 26, Table 3
data_provenance: SYNTHETIC measurements: combined-light magnitudes are generated from this file's own literature Teff/R/logg via PySeshat's own synthetic_binary_magnitudes(), plus Gaussian noise at an ASSUMED 0.03 mag representative precision -- a forward-model self-consistency check (does fit_photometry recover known input Teff/R/E(B-V) from data generated by PySeshat's own model), not a comparison to independently-observed sky photometry. See scripts/build_joint_benchmarks.py module docstring.

metallicity.source: nearest available CK04 grid point (ckp00); literature [Fe/H]=-0.04 (Torres et al. 2015) is not itself used -- only the solar-metallicity grid is downloaded for this project

radius_prior_note: 10% relative sigma Gaussian prior on each component's radius, tied to the literature value -- same convention as the other four Al-Wardat systems.
